xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order in Form GST APL-04 for FY 2017‑18 determining tax, interest and penalty under section 73 read with section 50 and section 122 of the MGST Act, 2017, and corresponding provisions of CGST/IGST Acts, in respect of scrutiny of GST returns of FDC Limited. ​
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Alleged excess availment of input tax credit not confirmed in GSTR‑2A/2B , excess ITC availment on tax head mismatch and late fees for delayed filling of annual return and interest and penalty on such amounts under section 73 and section 50 of the MGST/CGST Acts for the period 1 April 2017 to 31 March 2018. ​
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The order determines total dues of Rs. 28,39,092 comprising tax of Rs. 7,53,943 interest of Rs. 19,17,523 and penalty of Rs. 89,026 (IGST Rs. 7,33,757 CGST Rs. 10,52,667 SGST Rs. 10,52,667), which will be recognised as an expense/liability in the financial statements; the order is appealable and is not expected to have a material adverse impact on the company’s ongoing operations. ​
